name: Vehicle Interiors
author: Sixth Front
description: Sit inside your vehicles. In a tank, press C (CROUCH on phones) to take the commander's seat: vision blocks to look out of, the gun breech recoiling beside you, a rack of rounds behind, a live gunner's sight screen and switch panels. With the Jets or Bombers mod, C switches to the cockpit: jets get working radar, attitude and stores screens, a stick and throttle that move with you and a HUD in green; bombers get a framed flight deck with gauges, control wheels, four throttles and a co-pilot. In a helicopter you fly from the raised back seat with the gunner below in front (the Ka-52 seats you side by side with your co-pilot): canopy frames, a cyclic stick and collective lever that move with you, a live tactical map and flight screen (the Mi-24 has round gauges), dark Western cockpits and turquoise Russian ones.

// windows, vision blocks and canopy. C (CROUCH on phones) switches between the outside and inside view.

const gauges = (cols, rows, w, h, bg = '#1d1f1e') => tex(w, h, (x) => {

for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++) for (let j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
const cx = (i + 0.5) * cw, cy = (j + 0.5) * ch, r = Math.min(cw, ch) * 0.38;
x.fillStyle = '#0b0c0c'; x.beginPath(); x.arc(cx, cy, r * 1.12, 0, 7); x.fill();
x.fillStyle = '#151816'; x.beginPath(); x.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, 7); x.fill();

for (let k = 0; k <= 10; k++) { const a = Math.PI * 0.75 + (k / 10) * Math.PI * 1.5; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.78, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.78); x.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.95, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.95); x.stroke(); }
x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(cx, cy); x.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.8, cy + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.8); x.stroke();
if (k < 0.5) x.fillRect(px, py, 6, 10); else { x.beginPath(); x.arc(px, py, 4, 0, 7); x.fill(); }
for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) x.fillText(['PWR', 'AUX', 'NBC', 'FAN', 'LDR', 'TGT', 'RNG', 'COM'][i], 8 + (i % 4) * (w / 4), 14 + Math.floor(i / 4) * (h - 22));

const stripes = tex(64, 64, (x) => { x.fillStyle = '#e0b420'; x.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64); x.fillStyle = '#151515'; for (let i = -64; i < 128; i += 16) { x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(i, 0); x.lineTo(i + 8, 0); x.lineTo(i + 72, 64); x.lineTo(i + 64, 64); x.fill(); } });

const t = tex(cw, ch, (x) => { x.fillStyle = '#031006'; x.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch); });
const mat = keep(new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: t, toneMapped: false }));
const m = put(grp, keep(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(w, h)), mat, p, r);
return { mesh: m, tex: t, ctx: t.userData.canvas.getContext('2d'), w: cw, h: ch };
// shell walls seen from inside, with a band of vision blocks in front of the commander
